name: Strategic Initiatives Assessment
description: Framework for evaluating discussion of strategic initiatives and future direction

dimensions.name: Product Innovation
dimensions.description: Assessment of new product developments and innovation

criteria.name: New Product Announcements
criteria.question: What new products or services were announced or discussed?

evidence_requirements.description: Explicit mentions of new products or services

criteria.name: Innovation Investment
criteria.question: How is the company investing in innovation and R&D?

scoring_definitions.5: Significant innovation investment with clear allocation details

criteria.name: Geographic Expansion
criteria.question: What geographic expansion plans were discussed?

evidence_requirements.description: Specific mentions of new geographic markets or expansion plans

criteria.name: Customer Segment Growth
criteria.question: How is the company expanding into new customer segments?

scoring_definitions.1: No new customer segment strategy evident
scoring_definitions.5: Clear strategy for multiple new customer segments with specific plans

criteria.name: Competitor Awareness
criteria.question: How thoroughly does management address the competitive landscape?

scoring_definitions.5: Detailed analysis of competitive landscape with specific strategies

criteria.name: Competitive Advantages
criteria.question: What competitive advantages does the company highlight?

evidence_requirements.description: Specific mentions of competitive advantages or differentiators
